raw_dimensions_pdf.extraction_note: Found as adjacent vertical digits at same PDF X.

high_confidence_facts: Apartment east facade interior length = 13.802 m (PDF callout 13802 with vertical dim spanning the full east edge).
Top balkon E-W length = 5.709 m (PDF callout 5709, balkon area 7.60 m² → balkon depth = 1.331 m).
Top facade east section E-W = 4.922 m (PDF callout 4922).
Slaapkamer 1 N-S interior depth ≈ 4.000 m (PDF callout 4000), exterior-to-interior 4.201 m (PDF callout 4201). Top facade thickness ≈ 0.20 m.
Woonkamer strip width at north end E-W = 3.572 m (PDF callout 3572).
Slaapkamer 2 E-W width = 4.115 m (PDF callout 4115). Derived N-S depth = 4.593 m so 4.115 × 4.593 ≈ 18.90 m² matches label.
Bottom balkon N-S depth = 3.600 m (PDF callout 3600). Derived E-W width = 6.675 m so 6.675 × 3.600 ≈ 24.03 m² matches label.
Toilet interior = 0.880 × 1.785 m = 1.571 m² — but the room is LABELED 1.67 m² (NOT 1.57 as I assumed in PR #6). Re-check: maybe the toilet has an anteroom or the label includes door swing area.
Badkamer (klein) likely 1.670 × 2.289 ≈ 3.823 m² (label 3.81). 2.289 not directly labeled — inferred from area.
Apartment outer envelope at top facade level is approximately 10.7 m E-W (= 5709 + 4922 + ~70 mm wall, plus chamfer west of origin).

uncertain: WEST FACADE shape: in the rendered image the west wall has multiple jogs (visible as steps). The exact x-coordinate of each jog is NOT yet pinned to a PDF callout.
SW corner shape: the kitchen / slaapk2 south-west boundary kinks. Could not pin which callout dims which kink.
Chamfer (NW corner): no labeled dimension visible. Assumed ~1.0 m × 1.0 m bevel; could be 1.4 m or other.
Toilet area 0.88 × 1.785 = 1.571 m² but label says 1.67 m². May indicate the labeled area is the full toilet cell including a passage, or there's a dimension I missed.

Top facade total width: 5709 + 4922 = 10.631 m, but PDF callout 700 at the SE corner of the top edge suggests an additional 0.700 m beyond — does the 700 add to the total (10.631 + 0.700 = 11.331), or is it INSIDE the 4922 section?

Badkamer (klein) location: room-label position (py=785) is SOUTH of the gang label (py=633) but NORTH of slaapk2 label (py=882) — so badk klein sits between gang and slaapk2, NOT inside slaapk2's SE corner. PR #6 had this wrong.
Berging closets: two separate berging labels (north at py=605, south at py=540) — their exact polygons are not yet defined.
Door swings + opening positions: I noted door clear widths (~0.93 m and ~0.88 m) but not the position along each wall.

Multiple dim callouts (2700, 1500, 1180, 1285, 2090, 2730, 1645, 1375, 2220, 1200, 4585, 2330, 1435, 1765, 5765, 6207, 3535, 2115, 2201, 1800) are LIKELY interior/fixture dims (tubs, sinks, kitchen islands, door clears) and not envelope walls — but I have not verified each by tracing its arrows in the PDF.

Top balkon east-west placement: the dim 5709 starts at PDF px=146 (where chamfer ends?) and ends at px=470 (~where slaapk1/woonkamer wall starts?). If x_range_m given here is correct, the balkon door span overlaps the slaapk1/woonkamer interior wall — needs visual verification.
Bottom balkon east-west placement: anchored only by area + depth; exact x-range not pinned.
verification_checklist_for_user: Confirm origin: NW exterior corner of top facade, +X east, +Y south.
Confirm 5709 mm is balkon E-W length (not depth, not interior).
Confirm 4115 mm is slaapk2 E-W width.
Confirm 3572 mm is woonkamer strip E-W width.
Confirm ceiling height 2.80 m (from Technische Omschrijving — I cannot read that PDF here).
Confirm toilet area 1.67 m² (PDF text reads '1,67' but the small font may have been '1,57' — please check).
Confirm badkamer klein is BETWEEN gang and slaapk2 (not inside slaapk2).
Flag any uncertain item to resolve before Phase 2.
